name: Jellyfin ReleaseHub
overview: Unified TV series, anime and film release calendar for Jellyfin.
description: ReleaseHub adds a unified release calendar, tracking and discovery experience for TV series, anime and films directly inside Jellyfin. It reads your existing libraries, resolves each title against TVMaze, AnimeSchedule or TMDb using the provider IDs Jellyfin already holds, and shows what airs or releases next — including the next film of a saga you already own. It never modifies, renames, moves or downloads any media, and requires no Sonarr, Radarr or other external service.
